text:
Maria M.: Hey team — quick ask: we need a small 'sticker pack' of modular visuals for the launch social posts + a compact wireframe for the inbound lead routing page. Goal is grab-and-go assets for Growth and Sales. Can design take this?
Juan D.: Yep can do. Can you confirm sizes and priority lanes for the assets?
Maria M.: Priority: 1) benchmark hero tile (landscape & square) 2) 3 social stickers (cost, latency, reliability) 3) wireframe PNG + Figma page with hotspots for form + routing.
Sam (CreativeOps): Also need CTA variants for A/B — 'Try Redwood', 'See benchmark', 'Request capacity'. Nina: which two CTAs do we want on the inbound routing wireframe?
Nina G.: Start with 'See benchmark' (primary) and 'Request capacity' (secondary). Sales wants a direct capture for enterprise leads (company + size + use case).
Juan D.: Noted. File/export specs? color profile? Matt B.: Use brand palette v3 (link: https://redwood.design/brand/v3). Accessible contrast is required — check AA for text over images. For social stickers keep text to 2 lines max.
Maria M.: Format: master Figma + exported PNGs (1500px wide for landscape hero, 1200x1200 for square, 1080x1080 for stickers). Also SVG for diagrams. Include a 2-frame animated GIF variant for hero if easily possible.
Sam (CreativeOps): Timeline? I can batch these in the sprint but need 48 hours for the first pass.
Maria M.: Priority lane: 'Launch' (high) — deadline EOD in 2 business days. If blocked, escalate to @Juan.
Juan D.: Will start sketches today, dropping initial Figma link in this thread when ready.
design-bot: Reminder — brand compliance checklist attached at export time.
Juan D.: Quick question on copy: Nina, do we have short blurbs for the three stickers?
Nina G.: Yep — kept short: "Lower per-token cost", "Sub-50ms p95 latency", "Always-on fallbacks". Use sentence case.
Juan D.: Perfect. Also making a simplified diag for inbound routing showing: user -> webform -> routing rules -> Sales mailbox / Webhook / CRM. I’ll add labels for priority lanes.
Sam (CreativeOps): For the wireframe hotspots, can we map inputs to HubSpot fields? Nina: Sales confirmed yes, map company, size, use case -> hubspot.company_size, hubspot.use_case.
Maria M.: One more ask — include a small one-pager (PDF) for Sales with the three hero graphics and 2-line how-to for embedding the social stickers in customer emails. Keep it brand-safe.
Matt B.: I’ll do a quick brand sweep once Juan posts the Figma. If any color tweaks needed I’ll flag.
Juan D.: Uploading first pass now: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/launch-stickerpack (dropbox for review).
Maria M.: Thanks — I’ll route to Growth + Sales for a quick 2-hour review window tomorrow. If approved, Sam can do final exports.
Sam (CreativeOps): Got it. Will reserve export time Wed morning.
Nina G.: FYI — webinar landing page will reuse the square hero and the wireframe. Make sure the square has a centered headline safe zone.
Juan D.: Will add a 120px safe zone for headline.
Maria M.: Awesome — this looks actionable. If anything blocks, ping me with @Maria. :white_check_mark:
